candidates.change_summary: Remove the require check for integer overflow of depositsCount.
Change depositsCount increment to a fixed number assignment, altering the tracked count.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll, allowing anyone to call it and drain the contract.
Replace transfer with an external call that can fail silently, or replace withdraw with a no-op by substituting zero for the balance.
Remove the require check from onlyOwner, making the modifier always pass and allowing anyone to call protected functions.
Change the ownership check to always fail, permanently blocking any call to onlyOwner functions.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw to allow anyone to call it.
Replace msg.sender with address(0) so funds are sent to zero address instead of owner.
Replace transfer with call to potentially change gas behavior.
Change parameter from _value to address(this).balance so caller receives entire balance regardless of argument.
Remove the require check in onlyOwner so any caller passes the modifier.
Move the onlyOwner modifier invocation inside the function body after transfer, so it does not restrict the call.
